context.zh: 固奔陽城山，遣弟告急，矩遣郭誦屯洛口以救之。
context.idiomatic: Gu bolted to Yangcheng Mountain and begged for help; Li Ju stationed Guo Song at the Luo estuary to relieve him.
context.literal: Gu fled to Mount Yangcheng and sent his younger brother with an urgent plea; Li Ju sent Guo Song to hold the mouth of the Luo to relieve him.

context.zh: 及洛陽陷，屯於洛北石梁塢，撫養遺眾，漸修軍器。
context.idiomatic: After Luoyang fell he garrisoned Shiliang Fort north of the Luo, supported the survivors, and gradually repaired military equipment.
context.literal: When Luoyang fell, he encamped north of the Luo at the Stone Beam fort, comforted the surviving host, and gradually repaired military equipment.
